description: This file defines the ServiceValidationException class, a custom exception used within the org.apache.ofbiz.service package to handle validation errors related to services, including missing or extra fields and error modes.

classes.name: ServiceValidationException
classes.description: A custom exception class extending GenericServiceException, used for handling validation errors in services, with fields for messages, missing and extra fields, error mode, and associated service.

methods.name: getExtraFields
methods.description: Returns the list of extra fields involved in the validation error.

methods.name: getMissingFields
methods.description: Returns the list of missing fields involved in the validation error.

methods.name: getMessageList
methods.description: Returns the list of validation messages, or null if empty.

methods.name: getModelService
methods.description: Returns the ModelService associated with the validation exception.

methods.name: getServiceName
methods.description: Returns the name of the service associated with the exception, or null if none.

methods.name: getMessage
methods.description: Constructs and returns a detailed message string including the superclass message and validation messages.
